review_evidence: Basic.lean:32-163 defines Cfg, MPVSpace, mpvState, normalizedMPVState, mpvInner, mpvOverlap and proves 10+ lemmas about their properties
CastLemmas.lean:29-80 proves 7 cast-preservation lemmas for mpv, mpvOverlap, injectivity, block-injectivity, irreducibility, left-canonical condition, and gauge-phase equivalence
NormalTensorDichotomy.lean:47-210 proves overlap_dichotomy, mpv_phase_alternative, overlap_tendsto_zero_of_not_mpvBlockPhaseEquiv, and two unit-phase existence theorems
PeripheralToTransferMapGap.lean:33-43 proves overlap_tendsto_one_of_peripheralPrimitive_of_irreducible using QICLean channel theory
summary: Inspected all 7 files in TNLean/MPS/Overlap/. Each contains formal mathematical definitions, lemmas, and theorems related to MPS overlap theory: asymptotic decompositions (AsymptoticDecomposition.lean), core overlap definitions and basic properties (Basic.lean), cast-aware decay lemmas (CastDecay.lean), dimension-cast preservation lemmas (CastLemmas.lean), the normal-tensor overlap dichotomy (NormalTensorDichotomy.lean), periodic-ray unit overlap results (PeriodicRayUnitOverlap.lean), and peripheral primitivity to overlap convergence (PeripheralToTransferMapGap.lean). All files have non-trivial mathematical content with proofs, reference published literature (arXiv:1606.00608, arXiv:1010.3732), and are not pure import aggregators or duplicates.
